title: Greece on the Ruins of Missolonghi by Eugène Delacroix
episode: The cost of war: Delacroix, Greece on the  Ruins of Missolonghi
description: Delacroix’s painting of 1826, after the Greek town of Missolonghi fell to the Ottomans, with Greece as a woman kneeling on the rubble. It is the best-known work in the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux.
